retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually transcribed selected zero-based source rows; generated normalized facts
immutable_content_note: Immutable raw content was unavailable; retrieved master rows are not asserted byte-identical to the history-head revision.
limitations: Dedicated catalog membership retains the complete ABSORB_YEN counter, including money credit and money/MP/HP shortage cascade.
The requested amount is raw residual times one, not actual initial HP loss or Dark execution damage.
Source credit is capped at 99 and happens before target payment; it is not limited by target available money or actual money loss.
An insufficient target can lose MP and HP; the effect must not be simplified to a money-only transfer or money-only clamp.
A finalized-dead counter source can still receive its credit if the queued target is alive; payment HP loss is not attack damage and does not generate further counters.
Later ordinary defense does not subtract from the already decided payment amount.
The empty source attribute is neutral and participates in defense element composition rather than being omitted.
The record has no percentage, harm, disease, MP cost or retained miracle slot.
Unlike-counter ordering remains semantically significant and uses the existing ordered counter action representation.
Old server counter-defense acceptance is retained as source behavior; discrepancy from bot intent remains unresolved C05.
FOG counter188 and ILLUSION counter189 remain completely excluded.
Historical IDs and technical labels are not verified current official IDs or names.
Old acquisition weights are not verified official probabilities; upstream reports distribution uncertainty.
All fourteen earlier catalogs, fingerprints and miracle indices remain unchanged.

resolution.amount: Positive raw residual after ordinary defense, multiplied by one; the decided amount is independent of armor selected on the later money-counter response.
resolution.credit_first: counter source money = min(99, source money + full requested amount)
resolution.debit_second: target pays requested amount from money first, then MP, then HP, each floored at zero
